theme: Wanguo Outlets, Tianhe Road shopping district
intro:
Option A: Wanguo Outlets — sports shoes and clothing
Option B: Tianhe Road mall walk — Teemall, Taikoo Hui, Fashion Tianhe
Back by 14:30; rest for the early start tomorrow

backup.title: Backup: Shahe Clothing Market (only if more clothes are wanted)
backup.note: If energy remains after returning to the hotel in the afternoon, it is ~15 min by taxi from K Hotel. Stalls are fullest in the morning; many close in the afternoon.

items.title: K Hotel → Shahe Clothing Market (沙河服装城)
items.note: Taxi, ~15 min, or metro to Shaheding (沙河顶) station.

items.title: Shahe Clothing Market
items.note: T-shirts, denim, casual wear. Low prices; bargaining is expected. Some stalls are already closed by the afternoon.
items.tip: The wholesale market is crowded. Backpacks should be worn on the front and phones kept away.

food.name: Breakfast shops on Tiyu Xilu (体育西路)

items.title: K Hotel → Wanguo Outlets (万国奥特莱斯)
items.note: Taxi, ~20–30 min, on Jiangnan Avenue Middle, Haizhu District. Traffic jams start 700–800 m from the mall; it is easier to get out nearby and walk.

items.title: Wanguo Outlets
items.note: The Nike and Adidas super-flagship discount stores are each larger than six basketball courts. Good for sports shoes, tennis shoes and sportswear.
items.tip: Many sports brands also carry kids' clothing and shoes.

food.name: Restaurants in Wanguo Outlets
food.desc: The mall has a dining area; pick one and sit down.

items.title: More shopping or pick up missed items
Tianhe Road shopping walk
items.note: The malls are connected or adjacent; the whole route is walked. Lunch at Taikoo Hui or Teemall.

food.name: Teemall and Parc Central food (天河城、天环美食)

route.title: Teemall (天河城)
route.desc: Long-established mall, with New Year decorations at year end.

route.title: Parc Central (天环广场)
route.walk: Direct via the underground passage from Teemall

route.title: Taikoo Hui (太古汇)
route.walk: Exit Parc Central and walk east along Tianhe Road, ~10 min
route.desc: High-end brands and strongly design-led shops.

food.name: French patisserie at Taikoo Hui (太古汇法式甜品店)

route.title: Wong Chun Loong Herbal Tea (黄振龙凉茶)
route.walk: Search “黄振龙” in Amap and pick the branch near Tianhe Road
route.desc: Herbal jelly (龟苓膏), 24-herb tea (廿四味). Kids can have the milder Xia Sang Ju (夏桑菊).

route.title: Fashion Tianhe (时尚天河)
route.walk: ~10 min walk to under Tianhe Sports Center

items.title: Rest at the hotel
items.note: A proper afternoon rest; an early start is needed tomorrow for Hong Kong.
